description: This file defines a template class for JSON-RPC link management over WebSocket connections, including nested classes for communication channels, message handling, and plugin state monitoring within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: Template class managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, including message handling, plugin state monitoring, and asynchronous call management.

classes.name: SmartLinkType
classes.description: Template class providing a higher-level interface for managing plugin connections, subscriptions, and synchronous/asynchronous RPC calls.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel
classes.description: Inner class handling WebSocket channel creation, message sending/receiving, and connection state management.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel::FactoryImpl
classes.description: Singleton factory for JSONRPC message creation and resource management.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel::ChannelImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the JSON-RPC WebSocket channel, handling message transmission and reception.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Entry
classes.description: Represents an individual pending RPC call, supporting synchronous and asynchronous responses, timeouts, and aborts.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Handler
classes.description: Manages registration and invocation of RPC methods.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Statechange
classes.description: JSON container for plugin state change notifications.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CurrentState
classes.description: JSON container for current plugin state.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Connection
classes.description: Represents a plugin connection, managing subscriptions, state changes, and event handling.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Checks for expired callbacks and triggers cleanup.

methods.name: InternalInvoke
methods.description: Performs a JSON-RPC call with specified parameters and processes the response.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Constructs and sends a JSON-RPC message, managing pending call state.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON-RPC messages, matching responses or dispatching events.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event with a callback.
